source: Hook stdin recorded by a probe plugin's hooks.json (UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse) and one `devin -p --prompt-file --model --export` run; a second `devin -p --verbosity 0 --export` probe for the joined output
sanitized: Paths replaced with /work/... and /home/user; export messages, system prompts, reasoning and file contents removed; tool calls and metrics kept

files.prompt_skill.json: UserPromptSubmit for a plugin skill command
files.question_answered_pre.json / question_an: ask_user_question answered (one question); PostToolUse adds multi_select and answers to tool_input
files.question_cancelled_pre.json: ask_user_question cancelled by the human (no PostToolUse)
files.question_two_pre.json / question_two_pos: two questions answered in one call
files.subagent_tool_post.json: a tool call made by a background subagent: same session_id and prompt_id, no field telling it apart
files.question_invalid_pre.json: ask_user_question whose input failed Devin's tool validation (options without descriptions): no PostToolUse
files.(synthesized in tests): A skipped answer (skipped: true) was not captured; tests derive it from question_answered_post.json
files.review_export.json: reviewer run (structure only): ATIF-v1.7; the final agent message is the answer
files.joined_stdout.txt / joined_export.json: `devin -p` asked to say a sentence, read a file, then answer in JSON: standard output joins every agent message without a separator; the export keeps each agent message, and the last one is the answer (captured 2026-11-15 while fixing the reviewer)
